metadata.title: 80s Rock Band Portrait with Ochre Backdrop

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, grainy photograph of a five-member male rock band posing against a textured, mustard-yellow wall. The subjects are dressed in classic 1980s rock attire—leather jackets, denim, vests, and boots—with a desaturated, almost monochromatic skin tone that contrasts sharply with the saturated ochre background. The lighting creates hard, dark shadows against the wall, emphasizing the gritty, analog aesthetic.
coreVisualRelationships: Desaturated subjects against a highly saturated warm background
Hard directional lighting creating distinct drop shadows on the wall
Rough, grainy halftone texture across the entire composition
Vertical alignment of figures creating a rhythmic horizontal progression
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white treatment for the human figures
Visible film grain or print halftone effect

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five full-body figures arranged horizontally across the frame, occupying the lower two-thirds of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in light denim, acting as a tonal break between the darker outfits.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from left to right across the band members' faces, eventually settling on the typographic block in the upper right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space above the band's heads, primarily in the upper right quadrant for text placement.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background vs. zero saturation in the subjects; high value contrast between highlights and shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy weight with distressed or eroded edges
Tight letter spacing for primary text, wide tracking for sub-text
Black fill with thin white outlines or drop shadows
characterSpecificRedesigns: Eroded terminals to mimic old press printing
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy slab serif for the main name paired with a wide-tracked, small sans-serif for the album title.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif aesthetic with built-in texture.
Captures the raw, industrial feel of the original lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide-angle photograph of a five-member 80s rock band in leather and denim, standing against a textured mustard-yellow wall. Use high-contrast black and white for the people and high-saturation ochre for the wall. Apply a heavy film grain and halftone print texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned, heavy slab-serif text in the upper right corner. Use black fill with a thin white outline. Ensure the text has a distressed, eroded texture to match the background grain.

verificationChecks: Is the background a saturated ochre/mustard color?
Are the band members rendered in high-contrast B&W?
Is there a visible halftone or grain texture?
Is the text right-aligned in the upper right quadrant?

adjustableVariables: Saturation level of the yellow wall
Specific 80s fashion items (e.g., more leather vs. more denim)

mustAchieve: Distinct color separation between subjects and wall

postGenerationChecks: Check for 80s-appropriate hairstyles and clothing silhouettes.
Ensure the shadow cast on the wall matches the light source on the figures.
Verify the halftone pattern is consistent across the entire image.
Confirm the text is legible but appropriately distressed.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W subjects + Saturated Ochre Textured Wall + Heavy Halftone Grain + Right-Aligned Distressed Slab Serif Typography.
